This repository contains all scripts and modules for automated VM and Active Directory decommissioning, including prep, validation, logging, and process automation. Scripts are modular for team use and operational handoff.

- Keep all decom scripts modular and reusable.
- Prefer separating prep/validation from destructive actions.
- Use clear, team-friendly comments and help blocks.
- Ensure all scripts are PowerShell 5.1 compatible unless otherwise noted.
